set_review.differentiation_evidence: At full size and 320 px, the six plates use visually distinct physical mechanisms: a mechanical policy fork, an axonometric perimeter, a risograph exposure frame, a selected-span magnifier, an exploded meeting folio and an engraved purchase interlock. Each preserves four separate source-specific labels and a detached caveat; no set duplicates another story's mechanism.

visual_signature.layout: A tall stacked pair of policy plates at left connects to an inherited repository fork in the center, then an isolated pull-handle on the right depicts the separate on-demand launch. Use dark ink, teal and ochre. Blank plates and metal parts with clean silhouettes.
visual_signature.metaphor: Letterpress policy tree and cutaway release latch
visual_signature.annotation: Organization policy / Repository setting / Run on demand
visual_signature.palette: High contrast natural white and controlled editorial accent colors
visual_signature.hierarchy: Central explanatory mechanism dominates the text and image
visual_signature.perspective: Letterpress policy tree and cutaway release latch

visual_review.mechanism_and_quality_notes: Four exact labels read at 320 px. Flat letterpress-like policy plates route by a single arrow to the physical repository fork. The launch handle is visibly isolated, and all text is clear of the 40 px margin.

The orange directional connector starts at the harness's physical socket and traverses the blue boundary to the model inlet, with no arrow from credentials or data store.
